About Sarvam
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to help execute high-priority initiatives across Sarvam’s marketing function. You will work on a varied mix of market research, campaigns, product marketing, events and content, collaborating closely with teams across Marketing, Product, GTM and Design.
This is a hands-on role for someone who can bring structure to open-ended problems, move quickly from idea to execution and maintain a high bar for quality. Your work will contribute directly to how Sarvam takes its products to market, engages enterprise and developer audiences, and shows up across digital and in-person channels.

What You’ll Do
• 
Build campaigns across content, search, paid and community channels, from audience and messaging to execution and measurement.
• 
Work with Product, GTM and Marketing on launches, product assets and new growth initiatives.
• 
Plan and execute conferences, roundtables, meetups and other offline experiences across vendors, logistics, communication and on-ground delivery.
• 
Help grow developer and enterprise communities through events, partnerships, webinars and ongoing engagement.
• 
Improve Sarvam’s discoverability across SEO, content and AI-powered search.
• 
Conduct market, customer and competitive research, turning findings into clear briefs and recommendations.

What We’re Looking For
• 
High agency and execution ability, with a track record of taking ownership and delivering high-quality work.
• 
Strong organisation and follow-through; calm and detail-oriented under deadline pressure.
• 
Clear writing and structured thinking, with the ability to communicate ideas simply.
• 
Strong growth instincts across audience, message, channel, experimentation and measurement.
• 
Fluency with modern AI tools, with the ability to build workflows and automations that improve research, content, analysis and execution.
• 
Comfort with marketing tools such as CRM, email and basic analytics

Good to Have
• 
Experience running a campus event, community, newsletter, side project or a small business.
• 
Familiarity with growth channels such as email, SEO, paid acquisition, content, partnerships and community.
• 
Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Notion, HubSpot, analytics tools or basic video editing.
If you have work samples that demonstrate strong writing, structured thinking or execution, include them with your application.

Why Sarvam?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
• 
Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.
• 
High ownership and high impact from day one.
• 
Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems.
• 
Work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works and communicates.
If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

Headquarters: Beloit, WI 
 
URL: http://acculynx.com

Senior Software Engineer

AccuLynx is a fast-growing SaaS provider of business management software for roofing contractors. With more than 10 years in the business and impressive year-over-year revenue growth, we have quickly established ourselves as the leading software product in this multi-billion dollar industry.

AccuLynx is actively looking for smart and passionate Senior Software Engineers to join our growing Engineering team! We are headquartered out of Beloit, WI and would love to have you join us for major planning sessions and meetings, but this role has the option to be remote. We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to have mastered at least one language and be eager to master any technology or language in the future. If you want to be part of a collaborative team committed to providing a best-in-class software user experience, please read on!

What You Will Do:

• Support Engineering team in delivering well-written, well-tested code to complete new features or address issues in the product

• Collaborate on the design, implementation, testing and review of new features and fixes

• Review code and contribute feedback to improve the quality, readability, and testability of the code base across Engineering

• Architect, design, develop, deploy and operate services that serve AccuLynx’s thousands of users

• Use Agile process to experiment and improve on software development practices at AccuLynx

What might you work on?

• Implement real time communication tools to connect our customers.

• Create a fast and responsive work-scheduling application for use in the field.

• Build an automation platform so our customers can customize their workflow to reduce wasted movement.

• Solve advanced mapping and geolocation problems.

• Build out our public RESTful API.

• Review junior Engineering team members’ work for accuracy and provide coaching and feedback

• Perform other related duties as assigned

Your Qualifications:

• Top notch coding skills

• 7-10 years of software development experience

• 7+ years of full-stack web development: frontend, backend and database

• Smart and gets things done

• Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills

• Belief that performance is a feature

• Experience with our stack: Vue.js, C#, Sql Server, Redis, ElasticSearch, Git

• Confidence you will make a difference in our product

• Leverages AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows while maintaining high code quality standards

• Actively evaluates and integrates emerging AI coding assistants into the team's development process, sharing best practices to improve overall engineering velocity

Bonus Points If You Have:

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies.

• Understanding of HTML5 and mobile responsive development.

• Contributions to OSS projects or Stackoverflow.

• Availability for after hours support. We work at a sustainable 40h/week pace but sometimes things go bump in the night.

Why We Love AccuLynx:

AccuLynx’s success as the #1 business management software for roofing contractors over the past 11 years is thanks to us investing in our employees, maintaining company values and focusing on a strong company culture. Our positive work environment has allowed us to retain employees that have been with us since our company’s inception and has provided the solid groundwork for us to develop an industry-leading product while exceeding our customer’s expectations. Because of our commitment to our company values and culture, we were recently officially recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ organization, with 90% of our employees naming AccuLynx as a great place to work.

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for software, product and company culture achievements. Our team’s shared belief in AccuLynx's mission promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation and fun. We have built a benefits program to match the strength of our team. This program includes:

• Attractive compensation packages

• Flexible paid time off - 3 weeks off in your first year!

• Competitive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)

• 401K matching and safe harbor contributions

Our Interview Process:

We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to be a master of your domain and be eager to learn any technology or language in the future. We aim to reply to your application within a week of receiving it. Our interview process consists of several stages, each one allowing us get to know you better, professionally and technically. It is also an opportunity for you to gain a better understanding of our culture and the work we do at AccuLynx. The stages include:

• CV, open source code, or public portfolio review

• Phone interview with HR team

• Face to Face conversation with a few members of your team.

Applicants must be able to work legally within the United States. Please, no 3rd party inquiries.

AccuLynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and employing a diverse workforce. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/acculynx-senior-software-engineer

About Us

Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.

Each AI agent is purpose-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher-value work.

Built on a CX-native foundation, Observe.AI works with 300+ global brands in Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare and Consumer Services, including brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, to improve customer satisfaction, boost productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic Global Customer Success Operations professional to help scale our Customer Success organization globally.

This role will focus on understanding and optimizing the end-to-end customer journey, identifying operational gaps, improving processes, and developing insights that enable the Customer Success organization to operate more efficiently and deliver better customer outcomes.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in a global SaaS environment and be comfortable operating across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, and other cross-functional teams

What You'll Be Doing

Customer Success Operations

  • Support the development and execution of the global CS operating model and processes.
  • Partner with CS leadership and regional teams to standardize processes while accounting for regional requirements.
  • Support planning activities including customer segmentation, account allocation, capacity planning, coverage models, and CSM productivity.
  • Develop and maintain operational cadences, business reviews, and performance reporting.

Data & Analytics

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and analyses to provide visibility into CS performance and customer outcomes.
  • Reporting includes end to end customer journey i.e. deployment, day to day CS activities, account health & customer support reporting 
  • Analyze key metrics including GRR, NRR, churn, renewal rates, expansion, adoption, customer health, and CSM productivity.
  • Identify trends and translate data into actionable recommendations for CS leadership.
  • Support forecasting and scenario analysis related to customer retention and expansion.
  • Build client facing reporting and ensure the same is circulated at regular intervals 

Systems, Automation & AI

  • Partner with Business Systems and CS teams to optimize CRM and Customer Success platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve operational efficiency.
  • Evaluate and implement technology and AI solutions that improve CSM productivity and customer engagement.
  • Ensure operational processes, data, and systems remain scalable as the organization grows.
  • Manage the CS Tools end to end (Statisfy, Rocketlane, DevRev and others)

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, and Revenue Operations to improve the customer lifecycle.
  • Support improvements to Sales-to-CS handoffs and CS-to-Renewal/Expansion processes.
  • Lead cross-functional operational projects from problem definition through implementation and measurement.
  • Act as a trusted operations partner to CS leadership by bringing structure, analysis, and data-driven recommendations to business problems.

What You Bring to the Role

  • 7+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related function.
  • Proven experience working with Global Customer Success organizations, preferably within B2B SaaS or high-growth technology companies.
  • Strong experience mapping and optimizing the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Demonstrated experience improving CS processes, workflows, and operating models.
  • Strong understanding of CS metrics such as GRR, NRR, churn, renewal, expansion, adoption, and customer health.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable insights.
  • Experience working with CRM and CS platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with process automation, data visualization, and operational reporting.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, global, and evolving environment.

Perks & Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for self and family, including free online doctor consultations and additional wellness benefits
  • Accidental insurance and group term life insurance coverage
  • Privilege and sick leave in line with applicable statutory norms
  • Generous national and festive holidays, along with well-defined parental leave policies
  • Annual Learning & Development allowance to support continuous professional growth
  • Rewards and recognition programs designed to encourage and celebrate high performance
  • Regular team and culture-building events across the organization
  • Flexible benefits for tax optimisation, including meal cards, provident fund, and other options

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

Observe.AI is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Observe.AI does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Observe.AI also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

We welcome all people. We celebrate diversity of all kinds and are committed to creating an inclusive culture built on a foundation of respect for all individuals. We seek to hire, develop, and retain talented people from all backgrounds. Individuals from non-traditional backgrounds, historically marginalized or underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you are ambitious, make an impact wherever you go, and you're ready to shape the future of Observe.AI, we encourage you to apply. For more information, visit www.observe.ai.

About Us

HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation, Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

Job Overview 

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Procurement Manager to lead and optimize our software licensing, SaaS vendor portfolio, and overarching GTM/RevOps technology ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Procurement, Finance, IT, and Revenue Operations (Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success) to streamline the entire procurement lifecycle, drive strategic vendor relationships, and optimize multi-million dollar software spend. 

You will serve as the strategic subject matter expert on SaaS procurement, ensuring our GTM technology stack actively supports business growth and operational efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities  

  • Strategic SaaS Procurement & Lifecycle Management: Lead the end-to-end strategic sourcing and procurement framework for all corporate software and SaaS applications. Oversee vendor discovery, evaluation, complex contract negotiations, onboarding, contract renewals, and onboarding workflows.  
  • GTM & RevOps Tech Stack Governance: Drive the procurement strategy for tools across the Revenue Operations ecosystem—including CRM (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), Sales Engagement (e.g., Salesloft, Outreach), Revenue Intelligence (e.g., Clari, Gong), Data Intelligence (e.g., ZoomInfo), and Lead Routing (e.g., LeanData).  
  • Strategic Spend & Portfolio Optimization: Continuously evaluate usage analytics, user adoption rates, and contract terms to eliminate redundancy, right-size subscriptions, prevent shelfware, and maximize return on investment (ROI).  
  • High-Stakes Contract Negotiation & Vendor Management: Lead complex enterprise negotiations to secure optimal pricing, favorable commercial terms, SLAs, volume discounts, and price locks. Develop strategic relationships with key strategic SaaS vendors.  
  • Security, Risk & Compliance Alignment: Partner closely with IT, InfoSec, and Legal teams to ensure all SaaS vendors adhere to strict security protocols (SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA), compliance requirements, and risk frameworks prior to contract execution.  
  • Process Improvement & Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with executive leadership across BizOps, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and IT to establish transparent procurement governance, streamline approval workflows, and implement SaaS management best practices.

Essential Skills & Qualifications  

  • Experience: 8 to 15 years of progressive experience in SaaS procurement, strategic sourcing, RevOps, BizOps, or vendor management within a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.  
  • Domain Expertise: Deep hands-on knowledge of the GTM/RevOps technology ecosystem (CRM, Revenue Intelligence, Marketing Automation, Customer Success platforms) and SaaS licensing models.  
  • Financial & Analytical Acumen: Proven ability to build business cases, perform complex Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and ROI analyses, and leverage analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau).  
  • Negotiation & Legal Skills: Strong background in commercial contract terms, redlining SLAs, data privacy terms, and enterprise software pricing models. 
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills with a track record of influencing executive decision-makers and cross-functional leaders.  
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
